thread:
Priya: Quick sync: proposing a 'tiered onboard' flow for new catalog models. Goal: faster time-to-serve for community models, stricter runway for enterprise/pinned ones. Need buy-in on telemetry tags, rollback automation, and migration incentives.
Leo: sounds sensible. What's the difference vs current Ramp vs Safe?
Priya: two main differences: 1) explicit cost guardrails per-tier, 2) migration credit window for pinned customers to move later. Also standard telemetry tags like model.source, model.tier, canary.cohort.
Hana: telemetry tags are great. We'll need per-step health checks that feed the autoscaler. Suggest error-rate, p99-latency, and token-drop metric.
Kunal: on migration credits: customers ask for assistance when we deprecate. propose 3 months credits + migration playbook.
Priya: good. Draft acceptance gates (pass = green):
- perf.latency.p95 <= baseline*1.15 or <= 300ms
- perf.latency.p99 <= baseline*1.25 or <= 500ms
- quality.delta <= +1% absolute on primary eval set
- cost.delta <= +10% per 1k tokens
- stability.errors <= baseline + 0.5%
- telemetry.cache_hit >= baseline - 7%
- hallucination.delta <= +0.8%
Leo: add a compatibility check: tokenizer/token-ids identical or a migration shim validated. Also check kv-cache eviction pattern.
Hana: can we codify rollout steps? e.g., internal 0.1% -> partners 1% -> partners 5% -> public 10% -> full 100% with 48h hold at each step. Each step has auto-rollback if health-checks fail.
Priya: yes. timeline idea: preflight (5 days), internal canary (2 days), partner canaries (3-7 days depending on cohorts), progressive rollout (2 weeks).
Kunal: customer opt-outs are tricky. we need an API + consent flow so customers can pin to older model during migration. CS will manage exceptions and track payments.
Leo: automation tickets: rollback runbook, per-step health-check triggers, canary routing per-customer. I'll open them.
Hana: ops-bot: please create monitoring dashboards for new telemetry tags and a canary-alert rule set.
ops-bot: Monitoring template started: https://redwood.internal/monitors/templates/tiered-onboard (auto)
Priya: also propose 'deprecation runway' options based on customer tier: community 30 days, partners 60 days, enterprise 180 days with migration credits.
Kunal: +1 for credits tied to committed contract level. need PM signoff on $$ impact.
Leo: suggestion: run a scaled smoke at 20% traffic for 24h before final 100% cutover to catch emergent cache-punching issues.
Hana: agree. include cold-start vs warmed-cache scenarios in preflight.
Priya: action items:
- Leo: open automation & rollback tickets, add compatibility checklist by Thu
- Hana: dashboard + alert rules, define health-check thresholds by Thu EOD
- Kunal: draft migration credit policy and consent flow copy by Mon
- Priya: finalize tier definitions and playbook, loop in legal for consent text
Priya: anything else?
Kunal: please add a short note for sales about how long deprecation windows are and what credits look like.
Priya: will do. thanks team :rocket:
